artifact_excerpt: PM wrote 3 criteria: 'tests cover ceiling, unlimited, missing-issue branches', 'tests use real AsyncSQLiteStore', 'tests are NOT marked @pytest.mark.slow and pass under default pytest lane'. The third criterion is unusually specific (it pins a CI contract); the first two are well-shaped.
note: Strong with one unusual criterion (the slow-marker exclusion). Judges tend to over-weight the 'specific' criterion; the human label is 88 / 100, not 95, because the slow-marker rule could be brittle to legitimate slow tests.
